# duratom

> Durable, live Jotai atoms over a Y.Doc: read typed values, write validated patches, and re-render only when what an atom shows changes.

Rules an app must follow: set `docAtom` once per Jotai store; setting a typed atom merges a patch into the doc as it is at write time; invalid data comes back as `{ issues }`, never as an exception; a duratom atom follows the doc only while something is subscribed to it.

The npm package ships `llms-full.txt` (every doc in one file) and an agent skill at `skills/duratom/SKILL.md`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/KarolNov/duratom/blob/main/README.md): install, quick start, the main API by example
- [API reference](https://github.com/KarolNov/duratom/blob/main/docs/api.md): every export of `duratom`, `duratom/react` and `duratom/core`
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/KarolNov/duratom/blob/main/skills/duratom/SKILL.md): how to build with duratom, for coding agents

## Recipes

- [Sync between devices](https://github.com/KarolNov/duratom/blob/main/docs/recipes/sync.md): Connect the doc in `docAtom` to a sync server with y-partyserver on Cloudflare; every atom then shows and edits the shared state, with no change to the atoms.
- [Offline storage](https://github.com/KarolNov/duratom/blob/main/docs/recipes/offline.md): Save the doc in the browser with y-indexeddb, so the app opens with the last state and works offline; atoms don't change.
- [Repair a broken node](https://github.com/KarolNov/duratom/blob/main/docs/recipes/repair.md): Fix a node a peer stored with data your schema rejects, by setting its typed atom with a whole valid value.
